meta.title: Shizukuishi Ski Resort
meta.description: ~30 min from Morioka IC — legendary powder facing Mt. Iwate in an uncrowded, private mountain resort.

transit.title:
30 minutes
from Morioka IC.
transit.lead: ~30 minutes by car from Morioka IC on the Tohoku Expressway — a legendary resort facing Mt. Iwate. Pair with the Tohoku Shinkansen at Morioka Station for a premium weekend powder trip.
transit.imgAlt: Snowy drive from Morioka IC toward Shizukuishi — Iwate mountain scenery

primary.title: Private powder facing Mt. Iwate
primary.lead: Host of the 1993 Alpine World Championships — Alpine course to 36° and ungroomed zones. Near-zero lift lines mean you can own the deep snow on wide burns.
primary.imgAlt: Skier in deep powder at Shizukuishi — Mt. Iwate panorama

secondary.title: After skiing, Shizukuishi food & baths
secondary.lead: Matsubokkuri gelato, local soba, Morioka reimen yakiniku — step off the slopes into a food loop and Amihari hot springs.

onsen.title:
Amihari onsen &
Shizukuishi baths
onsen.lead: From sulfur springs at Arine Sanso to forest rotenburo at Yukotan-no-Mori and Takakura Onsen in the Prince Hotel — post-ski recovery is easy to plan.
onsen.whisper: Some guests find the Prince Hotel bath limited — routing to Amihari's hidden springs on the way home is a local favorite.
onsen.imgAlt: Steam from snow-view outdoor bath — Shizukuishi and Amihari onsen

arine.title: Amihari Onsen Arine Sanso
arine.lead: 13-7 Komagura, Nagayama, Shizukuishi. Milky sulfur water and Shizukuishi basin views. Day use available (verify on official site). TEL 019-693-3232.
arine.imgAlt: Sulfur bath and basin view at Arine Sanso — Amihari Onsen

yukotan.title: Minami-Amihari Yukotan-no-Mori
yukotan.lead: 3-6 Nekozawa, Nagayama, Shizukuishi. Forest open-air bath with warm hospitality. Day use available (verify). TEL 019-693-3600.
yukotan.imgAlt: Forest outdoor bath at Yukotan-no-Mori — South Amihari

takakura.title: Shizukuishi Takakura Onsen (Prince Hotel)
takakura.lead: Takakura Onsen, Shizukuishi. Open-air bath at Shizukuishi Prince Hotel — convenient right after skiing. TEL 019-693-1111 (verify).
takakura.imgAlt: Open-air bath at Takakura Onsen — inside Prince Hotel

nearbyOnsen.pairingLead: Morning: Morioka IC → Shizukuishi → afternoon: powder & CAT tour → Matsubokkuri gelato → evening: Arine sulfur bath → night: Morioka reimen yakiniku.

matsubokkuri.title: Matsubokkuri Ice Cream Farm
matsubokkuri.lead: 70-48 Hayasaka, Nagayama, Shizukuishi. Fresh milk and seasonal gelato — perfect in-car dessert after skiing. TEL 019-691-5030.
matsubokkuri.imgAlt: Handmade gelato at Matsubokkuri — Shizukuishi specialty

yamajyu.title: Yamajyu Hand-cut Soba
yamajyu.lead: 179-7 Takamaeda, Nagayama, Shizukuishi. A longtime soba shop in Shizukuishi's competitive soba scene. TEL 019-691-1158 (verify).
yamajyu.imgAlt: Hand-cut soba at Yamajyu — local Shizukuishi noodle shop

powder.title: Legendary powder & CAT tours
powder.body: Ungroomed zones and snowcat (CAT) tours reach premium powder beyond regular lifts. Skiing the 1993 World Championship course is a story core skiers seek.

morioka.title: ~30 min from Morioka IC
morioka.body: ~30 minutes by car from Morioka IC — pair with JR Morioka and a rental car for wider loops to Morioka city, Appi Kogen, and Amihari.

family.title: Kids free & Snow Land
family.body: Elementary-age lift tickets are free all season — Shizukuishi Snow Land offers moving walkways and snow play. Parents can take CAT tours while kids enjoy safe snow programs.
